<!-- ───────────────── WHAT I DO ───────────────── -->

## What I do {.section-heading .mt-5}

::: {.grid .mt-4}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .service-card}
### Agents on analytics data

Analytics agents and Text-to-SQL over real schemas on BigQuery, Snowflake, and SQL databases: schema and business-vocabulary grounding, enforced retrieval, and deterministic read-only guardrails.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .service-card}
### Agent evaluation & reliability

Eval suites scored on results, blind held-out cases, tracing, and failure analysis, so you know how often the agent is right and why it is wrong when it is not.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .service-card}
### Coding agents for engineering work

Code migrations, platform-migration validation, and pipeline redesigns done with coding agents under parity tests and row-level validation. The agent does the volume; the tests decide what ships.
:::

:::

::: {.section-note}
I also take on AI enablement and interim team leadership, and time series / telemetry ML. [The detail, with case studies, is in Selected Work →](consulting.qmd)
:::


<!-- ───────────────── FEATURED WORK ───────────────── -->

## Featured work {.section-heading .mt-5}

::: {.grid .mt-4}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .work-card}
### Text-to-SQL Against a Real ERP

Natural-language querying against a wide production ERP: enforced retrieval, deterministic guardrails, value-aware evaluation, and a streaming full-stack TypeScript/React app. Open-sourced as a synthetic rebuild that keeps the real traps.

[Read the essay](posts/2026-06-28-text-to-sql-real-erp/index.qmd){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary .mt-2}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .work-card}
### Code Migrations with Coding Agents

How to run a large code migration with coding agents: port the evidence before the syntax, test against behavioral oracles, and sequence the suite so the oracle leads the implementation. Follow-up: [What Counts as Evidence](posts/2026-05-02-what-counts-as-evidence/index.qmd).

[Read the essay](posts/2026-03-09-dont-port-the-syntax-port-the-evidence/index.qmd){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary .mt-2}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .work-card}
### SQL Pipeline Optimization

A years-old daily full-recompute pipeline redesigned into a validated incremental one: the largest daily job runs 5-10x faster and overall compute cost fell by more than 50%. The fastest design tested was wrong, and row-level validation caught it.

[Read the case study](posts/2026-04-07-fast-wrong-is-worse-than-slow-right/index.qmd){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary .mt-2}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .work-card}
### Cross-Platform Migration Validation

A validation system for a large Databricks-to-Snowflake migration: automated comparison across dozens of tables, historical result storage, and a live team dashboard — from zero to deployed in about a week using a coding agent.

[Read the case study](posts/2026-04-01-validating-a-data-platform-migration-with-an-ai-coding-agent/index.qmd){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary .mt-2}
:::
